tldr: 台股11月4日連五黑收42,948.91點，外資匯出、新台幣走貶，形成股匯雙殺。
AI供應鏈動能延續，鴻海AI伺服器機櫃週產能倍增、聯發科首顆AI ASIC第4季放量。
金管會預告穩定幣發行辦法，發行人限銀行及金融業主導合資，非銀行業者資本額至少3億元。

items.title_zh: 台股連五黑收42,948.91點，創逾三個月新低
items.title_en: TAIEX extends losing streak to five sessions, closing at 42,948.91 (2026-11-04)
items.summary_zh: 加權指數11月4日跌358.63點、跌幅0.83%，收42,948.91點，為連五個交易日下跌，盤中於41,855.82至43,741.54點大幅震盪，成交值約新台幣1.11兆元。權值王台積電終場跌1.53%收2,260元，但自盤中低點2,235元回升，收斂指數跌幅；市場同時觀望美國期中選舉。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index fell 358.63 points, or 0.83%, to 42,948.91 on Nov. 4, its fifth straight decline and lowest close in over three months, after swinging between 41,855.82 and 43,741.54. Turnover reached about NT$1.11 trillion as investors weighed US midterm elections. Heavyweight TSMC slipped 1.53% to NT$2,260 but rebounded off an intraday low of NT$2,235, trimming the index's losses.

items.title_zh: 外資匯出、新台幣走貶引發股匯雙殺
items.title_en: Foreign selling and a weak Taiwan dollar pressure Taipei shares (2026-11-04)
items.summary_zh: 外資持續匯出，台股與匯市同步承壓。新台幣11月3日收32.76元、貶1.68角創一年半新低，成交量52.75億美元為史上第四大；4日再貶3分開在32.79元，逼近33元整數關卡。匯銀人士指出，央行不死守特定價位，以「時間換取空間」因應資金外流。
items.summary_en: A "double kill" in stocks and the currency gripped Taiwan as foreign investors kept pulling funds out. The Taiwan dollar closed at 32.76 per US dollar on Nov. 3, down 1.68 jiao to an 18-month low, with FX turnover of US$5.28 billion — the fourth-largest on record — then opened Nov. 4 three cents weaker at 32.79, approaching the 33 level. Dealers expect the central bank to "trade time for space" rather than defend a set rate.

items.title_zh: 鴻海AI伺服器機櫃週產能倍增，上修AI營收展望
items.title_en: Foxconn doubles AI server rack capacity, lifts AI revenue outlook (2026-11-04)
items.summary_zh: 鴻海科技日表示，AI伺服器機櫃週產能已翻倍至每週2,000架，並上修今年資本支出規模。法人預期鴻海可維持逾四成AI伺服器市占，並優先取得新世代產品參考設計，公司估明年AI營收占比有望提高至四至五成。
items.summary_en: At its tech day, Hon Hai (Foxconn) said weekly AI server rack capacity has doubled to 2,000 units and raised its 2026 capital-spending plan. Analysts expect the contract manufacturer to hold more than 40% of the AI server market and win early reference designs for next-generation products, with AI-related revenue potentially reaching 40–50% of the total next year.

items.title_zh: 聯發科首顆AI ASIC出貨，Q4營收估季增最多32%
items.title_en: MediaTek's first AI ASIC ships, Q4 revenue seen up as much as 32% (2026-11-02)
items.summary_zh: 聯發科首款資料中心AI加速器9月起出貨，第4季大幅放量，可望達成25億美元營收目標；管理層估該專案2027年營收上看160億美元、約占AI ASIC市場二成，並已取得第二家非中國資料中心客戶。公司財測第4季營收2,101至2,218億元、季增25%至32%。
items.summary_en: MediaTek said its first data-center AI accelerator began shipping in September and will ramp sharply in Q4, keeping it on track for a US$2.5 billion revenue goal; management sees the program reaching the high end of US$16 billion by 2027, about 20% of the AI ASIC market, and has landed a second non-China data-center customer. Q4 revenue is guided at NT$210.1–221.8 billion, up 25–32% from the prior quarter.

items.title_zh: 央行以「時間換空間」因應外資匯出、新台幣走貶
items.title_en: Central bank chooses to "trade time for space" as outflows weaken the NT dollar (2026-11-04)
items.summary_zh: 外資加速匯出，新台幣貶至一年半低點、盤中逼近33元關卡。據報導，央行不死守特定價位，內部進行沙盤推演並「以時間換取空間」，並放寬出口商每日賣匯額度協助穩盤。這波資金外流凸顯銀行與壽險的外匯部位承壓。
items.summary_en: With foreign investors accelerating withdrawals, the Taiwan dollar fell to an 18-month low and tested the 33-per-dollar level intraday. Reports say the central bank is not defending a specific exchange rate but running internal scenarios and "trading time for space," reportedly easing exporters' daily FX-selling limits to help smooth the slide. The pressure highlights how capital flows are squeezing banks' and insurers' foreign-exchange positions.

items.title_zh: 金管會預告穩定幣發行辦法，科技業不得獨資發行
items.title_en: FSC pre-announces stablecoin issuance rules; tech firms barred from going solo (2026-11-03)
items.summary_zh: 金管會11月3日預告「穩定幣發行許可及管理辦法」草案，並同步預告8項VASP授權命令及洗錢防制修正。發行人限銀行、金控及金管會核准機構，非銀行發行人實收資本額至少3億元；採合資須由金融業持股過半，科技業無法單獨發行。幣別僅限與新台幣或單一外幣1:1連結，預告期40天。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission on Nov. 3 unveiled draft rules for licensing and managing stablecoin issuers, alongside eight VASP-related orders and anti-money-laundering amendments. Issuers are limited to banks, financial holding companies and approved institutions; non-bank issuers need at least NT$300 million in paid-in capital. Joint ventures must keep financial firms as majority owners, so technology companies cannot issue alone. Only stablecoins pegged 1:1 to the NT dollar or a single foreign currency are allowed, with a 40-day comment period.

items.title_zh: 高資產族群持續布局境外資產，財管規模攀升
items.title_en: Taiwan's wealthy keep shifting into offshore assets as high-asset AUM climbs
items.summary_zh: 玉山與KPMG報告預估，今年台灣資產逾1億元的高資產客戶將增至約12.4萬人，逾七成已布局境外資產。金管會資料顯示，截至5月底銀行高資產客戶達25,290人、管理資產2.66兆元；存款占比降至42.5%，債券、保險與境外結構型商品占比上升。
items.summary_en: A KPMG–E.Sun report projects the number of Taiwanese with over NT$100 million in assets will rise to about 124,000 this year, with more than 70% already allocating to offshore assets. FSC data show banks' high-net-worth clients reached 25,290 by end-May with assets under management of NT$2.66 trillion, as deposits fell to 42.5% of holdings and bonds, insurance and offshore structured products gained share.

items.title_zh: 債券與結構型商品成高資產配置主力
items.title_en: Bonds and structured products lead high-net-worth portfolios
items.summary_zh: 中國信託與BCG報告指出，高資產客群優先增持項目中債券占49%居首，結構型商品與不動產各占28%。超高資產族群境外資產配置比重約69%，但高度配置（逾總資產20%）僅約35%。銀行多將海外債、結構型商品與DCI計入財管門檻，反映收益型與跨境商品需求穩定。
items.summary_en: A CTBC–BCG wealth study found bond products topped the priority list for Taiwan's wealthy at 49% of allocations, followed by structured products and real estate at 28% each. Offshore allocation reached about 69% of ultra-high-net-worth portfolios, though heavy allocations (over 20% of total assets) stayed near 35%. Banks increasingly count offshore bonds, structured notes and DCI toward wealth-tier thresholds, signaling steady demand for yield-oriented, cross-border products.
